career_ladder.note: Apprentices at Indian Oil Corporation Limited undergo 1 year of statutory training under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Successful apprentices who transition into permanent non-executive technical cadres (such as Junior Engineering Assistant - IV) advance through IOCL's structured non-executive promotion policy towards executive officer positions.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Apprentice and non-executive posts is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Test followed by a Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT) and Document Verification. The SPPT is qualifying in nature.

financial_package.note: Trade and technician apprentices receive monthly statutory stipends as mandated under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Regular non-executive technical staff (JEA-IV) receive basic pay of ₹25,000 in Grade IV with 58% IDA constant as of 2025-07-01, HRA, industrial allowances, and medical cover.
financial_package.pay_level: Apprentice Stipend (₹10,500 – ₹15,000/mo); Regular Post Grade IV (₹25,000 – ₹1,05,000)
financial_package.pay_source_label: IOCL Terms of Engagement and Non-Executive Pay Matrix
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Grade IV regular scale: Basic Pay ₹25,000, 58% IDA (₹14,500), HRA (18% to 27% = ₹4,500 to ₹6,750), and industrial perks (approx. 32% = ₹8,000), less standard statutory deductions.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) indexed to AICPI
Company township residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Cafeteria approach perks and allowances up to 32% of basic pay
